title: Robinsons Land starts work on 29-story Bridgetowne office tower

blocks.text: MANILA, Phililippines — Robinsons Land Corp. (RLC) has started construction of a 29-story office tower in Quezon City that will add 51,400 square meters (sq m) of gross leasable area (GLA) to its Bridgetowne estate by 2028. The project, called Bridgetowne One, will expand the estate’s office footprint to approximately 347,000 sq m, the company said. READ: Robinsons Land bags KMC Solutions office deal In addition, its office development and leasing arm, Robinsons Offices, already has seven developments in Bridgetowne with more than 295,000 sq m of GLA.
